effects.printed_clause: 2 Level 7 or higher "Aquamarine" Fusion Monsters; must be Fusion Summoned.
effects.lua_implementation: AddFusionProcMixRep requires exactly two Level 7+ Aquamarine Fusion monsters; EFFECT_SPSUMMON_CONDITION with aux.fuslimit enforces Fusion Summoning.

official_references.matched_structure: Fusion material procedure and Fusion-only summon-condition structure.

effects.printed_clause: Unaffected by other card effects while "Aquamarine Glaucus" or "Aquamarine Physalia" is in your GY.
effects.lua_implementation: A single-range immunity checks either listed passcode in the controller's GY and rejects every effect whose owner is not this card.

effects.printed_clause: Main-Phase Quick Effect: banish another "Aquamarine" Fusion from your GY; inflict 1000, usable up to other Level 8+ Aquamarines per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Main-Phase Quick Effect pays the filtered GY banish cost, deals fixed damage, and consumes a turn flag bounded by the current count of other Level 8+ Aquamarines.

official_references.matched_structure: Quick effect with cost, damage/operation structure, and phase reset.

coverage_override.reason: The Fusion materials plus Fusion-only Summon condition form one procedure unit, the conditional immunity is one continuous effect, and the damage Quick Effect includes its cost and dynamic usage ceiling.
